help.enlivraison: All parcels in active delivery, including alerts and treated alerts. The Alerts tab contains only parcels in alert.
help.enlivraisonAgency: Parcels on the road with no problem. As soon as a parcel is flagged as an alert, it moves to « Alerts ».
help.alertes: Parcels flagged by the delivery company or the livreur (the statuses chosen in Preferences › Suivi alerts). Call the customer, then “Treat” or “Customer cancels”.
help.alertes_new: Alerts nobody has worked on yet: call the customer.
help.alertes_encours: Alerts someone is already working on (a call, a note…). Finish with « Treat » or « Customer cancels ».
help.traites: Alerts already handled: the parcel is back on the road. It leaves this list once delivered or cancelled.
help.livres: Parcels delivered in the last 30 days.
help.annules: Parcels cancelled by the customer, still with the courier or the livreur, on their way back to the depot. To give one directly to another customer: Suivi → Swap.
help.swap: The parcels a swap can take now. ZR: while it accepts it (« Commande annulée » or « Ne répond pas 3 », before the return), ZR makes it through its API in one click. Other companies and our livreurs: the parcels coming back. Below: the parcels already swapped.
help.bloques: Parcels with no new status for several days (Preferences). Call the company, the livreur or the customer, then say what you did. Still no news 2 days later: a claim goes by itself (companies with an API).

empty.livres: No parcel delivered in the last 30 days.
empty.annules: No cancelled parcel on its way back.

rec.searchPh: Customer name, phone, ref. PX…, tracking number
rec.searchInfo: Claims desk: type a name, a phone number (even part of it), a PX… reference or a tracking number. All orders are searched, whatever their status or date. Click an order to see its full history.
rec.companiesHelp: ZR Express: the claim is created directly in your ZR account, and its answer comes back here (Refresh answers). Yalidine, NOEST… have no API for claims: Pilotix prepares the full message (tracking, ref., customer, problem) and sends it by WhatsApp or e-mail to their customer service. Each claim stays here until answered; after 48 h without answer it turns red: remind in one click.
rec.livreursHelp: For parcels of your own livreurs: the message goes to the livreur's WhatsApp. Write down the answer here.
rec.emptyOpen: No claim waiting. To create one: « + New claim ».

rec.noContact: No WhatsApp or e-mail saved for {{name}}: WhatsApp will let you pick the contact, or copy the message.
rec.answerPh: What the courier answered, or what was done
